predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Norwich City vs Cardiff City: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Crises & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Norwich Home Win / Draw (led by a 2:1 home victory) paired with Over 2.5 goals and BTTS: Yes best reflects Norwich's pressing edge against Cardiff's depleted defense and mutual clean-sheet fragility.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw with Norwich Home Win leading against Cardiff's winless away defense (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes driven by 3.66 combined lambda and zero venue clean sheets (Confidence: High, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: Cardiff strike first on transition before conceding a draw in an open 2:2 exchange (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Norwich's 93.8-percentile high press targets Cardiff's injury-hit backline at Carrow Road.

spf.comment: Covers a 2:1 Norwich win exploiting Cardiff's four-defender absence and 0-for-7 away record, plus a 2:2 draw branch given Touré's absence and Norwich's zero home clean sheets, where a single call ignores the narrow 0.26 lambda gap.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.66 combined lambda (70.8% Poisson Over 2.5), Norwich's 80.0% seasonal Over 2.5 rate, and Cardiff's 1.73 xGA per match with four defenders out.

btts.comment: Backed by 70.2% Poisson BTTS probability, Cardiff's 1.86 xG per match, and neither side recording a single clean sheet in tonight's home or away venue role.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Norwich's pressing dominance over Cardiff's depleted defense with Touré absent; 2:2 captures Cardiff breaching Norwich's win-or-lose home backline in an open shootout.

goals.comment: Three (21.0%) and four (19.2%) total goals represent the top two Poisson densities around the 3.66 lambda total and align directly with 2:1 and 2:2.

bqc.comment: Win-Win mirrors Cardiff trailing at HT and losing in four of seven away matches; Loss-Draw reflects Cardiff leading twice at HT away before drawing both.
